title: AWS Fargate to Amazon EventBridge
description: Create an AWS Fargate service that sends events to EventBridge

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This project contains a sample AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) template for deploying an AWS Fargate service running on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS) cluster with an Application Load Balancer in-front. The AWS Fargate service makes putEvents calls to an Amazon EventBridge Event Bus. This template uses a custom image without having to pre-push the image to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (ECR) or another container library. This makes use of the in-built ecs.ContainerImage.fromAsset method.

The custom image has a base route / for health checks, and /putevents route for putting events to the event bus. Environment variables like the event bus name and AWS region are passed to the image to enable it to perform actions on the event bus.

This project also shows how to set up an CloudWatch Events Interface Endpoint to the VPC. A VPC Endpoint policy is created to only allow the Fargate task definition to perform actions through the VPC endpoint.
